limits: Source proposed only; no runtime results or assertion counts are claimed.
Staged field/reference snapshots are not an atomic transaction against concurrent caller mutation. Payload hashes bind the final owned copies, not a claimed atomic instant of original bytes.
Control-file cap counts serialized record plus actual additional artifact payload bytes; it is not a cap on all CLR/input/snapshot/StringBuilder/string memory or CPU time.
Raw scans and sorting are bounded by data caps, not a hard-RT or outage availability guarantee. Fatal runtime survival is not promised; getters can fail to allocate their defensive copies.
Only the validated TryBuild construction path is supported; an in-assembly bypass of the internal constructor is not a new sanctioned authority or acceptance path.
No file/hash/reparse/lease/OWNER/registry/inventory completeness or host safety proof is provided. Standalone count does not infer any missing files.
Portability remains a future follow-up only; no new architecture or mission is introduced.
